name: Guobo Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Guobo Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of active phased array transmitter and receiver components and radio frequency integrated circuits in China. It offers active phased array T/R modules, RF modules, RF amplifier chips, and RF control chips for research institutes, OEMs, and mobile communication equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
